subject: session: fix rollback on killed txn may panic (#64001)
summary: Diff adds a defensive `SetMemoryFootprintChangeHook(func(uint64){})` in `(*LazyTxn).Rollback()` to prevent memdb footprint hook execution during rollback, avoiding panics when the session memory tracker’s SQLKiller has an active kill signal. A regression test (`TestPanicOnRollbackKilledTxn`) sets up a killed session and asserts `Session().Close()` (which rolls back) does not panic. Later history on `pingcap/master` retains the same rollback-hook swap, with no follow-up fix needed for correctness in this area.
